scope: WCAG 2.2 AA audit of the working tree (no frontend diff vs cce584c). Headless Chromium keyboard-only walk: login (bad + good password), board tab order, New Bug open/trap/Escape/validation/save, search type + clear, open row by Enter, edit + save, Delete -> confirm -> Escape -> Delete, Open/Closed toggle, sort header, logout. ariaSnapshot per view, computed-style contrast for 22 colour pairs, reflow at 320 CSS px, target sizes. One [a11y] bug created per run and deleted by keyboard (plus one leftover from an aborted run deleted via API).

findings.title: Specs contain no accessibility requirement
findings.requirement: specs/design/theme.md 'Other UI/UX' (accessibility placeholder); WCAG 2.2 AA used as authority
findings.evidence: theme.md leaves accessibility as '(... accessibility, and other design rules can be added here ...)'. No feature spec has an a11y acceptance criterion; no a11y tests exist (tests/example.spec.ts targets playwright.dev).
findings.fix: Add an accessibility section to theme.md committing to WCAG 2.2 AA (contrast, focus management in modals, keyboard operation, reflow at 320px) and an a11y acceptance criterion per feature.

findings.title: Search input has role="search", so it is exposed as a landmark, not a textbox
findings.requirement: WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
findings.evidence: ariaSnapshot of banner: `search "Search bugs by title"` - no textbox role; editable field announced as a region. See evidence/a11y/aria/03-board.yml.
findings.repro: Log in, run page.locator('header').ariaSnapshot(); the input appears as `search`, not `textbox`/`searchbox`.
findings.fix: Remove role="search" from the <input>, use type="search" (searchbox role), and put role="search" on the wrapping <div>.

findings.title: Bug table rows have role="button", destroying row semantics
findings.requirement: WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
findings.evidence: ariaSnapshot: tbody children are `button "87 MID [a11y] keyboard walk ... buggy"` containing cells, not `row`. The button name concatenates every cell; table row/column navigation is broken. Keyboard activation itself works (Enter on row opened 'Edit bug #87').
findings.repro: Log in; page.getByRole('table').ariaSnapshot() -> rows listed as button.
findings.fix: Remove role/tabIndex/onKeyDown from <tr>; render the Title (or ID) cell content as a <button> that calls handleRowClick; keep the <tr> onClick for mouse users.

findings.title: Open/Closed toggle selected state is conveyed only visually
findings.requirement: WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; 1.4.1 Use of Color
findings.evidence: After Space on Closed: Open aria-pressed=null, Closed aria-pressed=null, no aria-current. ariaSnapshot shows plain `button "Open"`, `button "Closed"`. Selected state is only the #b8ae76 fill, which is 2.25:1 against the white track.
findings.repro: Tab to Closed, press Space, read getAttribute('aria-pressed') on both buttons.
findings.fix: Add aria-pressed={stateFilter === "OPEN"} and aria-pressed={stateFilter === "CLOSED"} to the two buttons.

findings.title: Create and Edit modals do not trap focus; Tab walks into the page behind
findings.requirement: WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order; 2.1.2 (aria-modal="true" contract); theme.md modal consistency
findings.evidence: Create bug: Tab 6 from title -> BODY, Tab 7 -> search field, 8 New Bug, 9 Logout, 10 Open (all outside dialog). Edit bug: Tab 7 -> BODY, then search, Clear search, New Bug, Logout, Open. Close X is also skipped on the way out. keyboard-path.log lines 'Trap test'; screenshot 06-create-modal-focus-escaped.png.
findings.repro: Open New Bug with Enter, press Tab 7 times, check document.activeElement.closest('[role=dialog]') is null.
findings.fix: Use native <dialog>.showModal(), or set `inert` on #root content while a modal is open, or add a Tab/Shift+Tab wrap handler on the panel.

findings.title: Focus is dropped to <body> after closing a modal, saving, deleting, or clearing search
findings.evidence: Escape right after opening Create from New Bug -> BODY. Save (create) -> BODY. Save (edit) -> BODY (not the row). Confirm Delete -> BODY. Escape on delete confirm -> BODY. Enter on Clear search -> BODY (button becomes visibility:hidden). Keyboard users restart from the top of the page each time.
findings.repro: Focus New Bug, Enter, Escape; document.activeElement === document.body.
findings.fix: Store the trigger element when opening and call .focus() on it in onClose (New Bug, or the row's button); after delete focus the table or next row; after Clear search focus the search input.

findings.title: Delete confirmation dialog does not receive focus; focus stays behind it in the Edit dialog
findings.requirement: WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order; 4.1.2 (two simultaneous aria-modal dialogs)
findings.evidence: Enter on Delete -> focus remains on `button "Delete" (in dialog "Edit bug #87")` under the overlay; Tab 1 -> Edit dialog Cancel, Tab 2 reaches 'Delete bug' Close. ariaSnapshot 10-confirm-delete.yml exposes both dialogs; screenshot 10-confirm-delete.png shows the focus ring on the dimmed Delete.
findings.repro: Open a bug, focus Delete, press Enter, read document.activeElement.
findings.fix: Focus the confirm dialog's Cancel button when showConfirmDelete becomes true, make the Edit dialog inert while it is shown, and return focus to Delete on cancel.

findings.title: Severity badge text fails 4.5:1 on its own tint (HIGH 3.77, MID 2.93, LOW 4.32)
findings.evidence: Computed in app: HIGH #b84a2e on #efd7d1 = 3.77:1 (3.66 hovered); MID #a67c47 on #ebe2d7 = 2.93:1 (2.85 hovered); LOW #4a6b5e on #d7dedc = 4.32:1 (4.20 hovered). Badge is 14px/600, not large text. contrast.json.
findings.fix: Darken the text colours (e.g. HIGH #a24128, MID #7e5e36, LOW #47675a reach ~4.6:1 on white rows; go slightly darker for hovered rows) or lighten the tint; update spec 08 hex values to match.

findings.title: Login 'Log in' subtitle in #b8ae76 on white is 2.25:1
findings.evidence: #b8ae76 on #ffffff = 2.25:1 at 16px/500. (Contrast of stone-800 text on the beige primary is fine at 6.76:1.)
findings.fix: Use text-stone-700, or add a darker brand shade for text (e.g. #7a7040, 4.98:1).

findings.title: Search placeholder text is 2.41:1
findings.evidence: placeholder computed rgb(168,162,158) (#a8a29e) on #fafaf9 = 2.41:1; on white when focused 2.52:1. The placeholder is the only visible label.

findings.title: Focus ring, input borders and selected toggle fail 3:1 non-text contrast
findings.requirement: WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (2.4.7 relies on it)
findings.location: frontend/src/*.tsx focus:ring-primary classes; input border-stone-300; BoardPage.tsx:168
findings.evidence: Focus ring #b8ae76 vs white 2.25:1, vs stone-100 page 2.06:1 (inputs get only a 1px ring). Input border #d6d3d1 vs white 1.49:1. Selected toggle fill vs track 2.25:1. Table rows fall back to Chrome's default blue outline (passes) because they have no custom focus style.
findings.fix: Use a darker ring (e.g. focus:ring-stone-700, or a #7a7040 brand shade), border-stone-500 on inputs, and add a border or check to the selected toggle.

findings.title: Board header does not reflow at 320 CSS px (400% zoom); Logout is off-screen
findings.evidence: At 320x640: documentElement.scrollWidth 524 vs clientWidth 320; New Bug at x 313-413 and Logout at x 438-524 need horizontal scroll; the h1 collapses to 0 px wide and the search box covers the logo. The table's own horizontal scroll is allowed by the 1.4.10 exception. /login reflows (320 = 320). Screenshot 14-board-320.png.
findings.repro: Open /board with viewport 320x640 and compare document.documentElement.scrollWidth to clientWidth.
findings.fix: Add flex-wrap to the header, drop flex-shrink-0 on the button group, and make the search w-full below sm (e.g. `w-full sm:w-80`).

findings.title: Clear-search button is 22x36 px, next to the input
findings.evidence: Measured 22x36 px; it sits right next to the search input, so the spacing exception does not apply. Modal Close X measures 18x32 px but has no adjacent target, so it passes on spacing.
findings.repro: page.locator('button[aria-label="Clear search"]').boundingBox() with search text entered.
findings.fix: p-2 or min-w-6 min-h-6 on the clear button (and on the Close X for consistency).

findings.title: Submitting login drops focus to <body> because the fields are disabled while loading
findings.evidence: Enter with wrong password -> BODY; after the 'Invalid username or password.' alert, the user has to Tab back into the form. The error is announced via role=alert, but the fields have no aria-invalid or aria-describedby.
findings.repro: On /login type a bad password, press Enter, read document.activeElement.
findings.fix: Use readOnly/aria-disabled instead of disabled during submit, or focus the username field when setting error; add aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at the error.

findings.title: Page title is 'BuggyBoard' on every route
findings.fix: Set document.title per route, e.g. 'Log in - BuggyBoard' and 'Board - BuggyBoard'.

findings.title: Login page has no main landmark and 'Log in' is a paragraph, not a heading
findings.evidence: ariaSnapshot 01-login.yml: no landmark at all; `paragraph: Log in`.
findings.fix: Wrap the card in <main> and make 'Log in' an <h2> (or wrap it in a labelled <form>).

findings.title: Screen reader announcements (sort change, filter change, dialog open, save result) not verified
findings.evidence: aria-sort is set correctly on the active header (Title -> ascending, others null) and the arrow is aria-hidden, but nothing announces a sort, filter, save or delete result, and no status live region exists. No real screen reader was run.
findings.repro: Manual check with VoiceOver/NVDA: activate a sort header, toggle Closed, save a bug.
findings.fix: Add a visually hidden role=status region announcing e.g. 'Sorted by Title ascending', 'Showing 3 closed bugs', 'Bug saved'.
